The week

The world wrapped in one place

Last week was full of goodbyes. We had to say goodbye to the friends we've been with since our very first day of Erasmus. Most of the people who left were Spanish, so we never really needed to speak English with them.

This week has been the complete opposite, with lots of new people arriving from different countries such as Morocco, Armenia, and many others. Getting to know them has been a really interesting experience. Everyone has different hobbies, interests, and ways of seeing things, which makes every conversation a chance to learn something new.

Even though we sometimes struggle to understand each other, we always do our best to communicate. We mainly speak English with the new students, but some of them also know Spanish, which makes things a bit easier sometimes. It's nice to see how, even with different languages and cultures, we can still connect and enjoy spending time together.
